FN-ITVYZZ6-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 127
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 127 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Athletic
Commission until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
